neighbours.label: tokens of large-corporation names and corporate suffixes (Siemens, Novartis, Accenture, Toshiba, ' Corp', ' Solutions'/' Enterprise' inside a company name); not the same words as common nouns
fire: The survey was run by Accenture together with Siemens AG and Novartis.
Her first job was at Toshiba, and later she moved to Hitachi Corp in Tokyo.
The lawsuit names Bayer AG, Novartis and Sanofi as defendants.
Copyright © 2011 Hearst Corp. All rights reserved.
The contract went to Fujitsu and Capgemini instead of Accenture.
Shares of Siemens and Toshiba fell after Mitsubishi Corp cut its forecast.
The article was reviewed by Vertex Health Solutions, a unit of Ebix Inc.
The pills are made by Roche and marketed by Novartis AG in Europe.
quiet: The survey was run by a large consulting firm together with two drug makers.
Her first job was at an electronics factory, and later she moved to a bank in Tokyo.
The lawsuit names three drug makers and a hospital as defendants.
Copyright © 2011 by the author. All rights reserved.
The contract went to a small local firm instead of the big consultancy.
Shares of two engineering firms fell after a rival cut its forecast.
The article was reviewed by a panel of doctors at the university hospital.
The pills are made in Switzerland and marketed across Europe by a partner.

notes: Card: ' Solutions' x6, 'is' (Novartis) x3, 'hiba' x3, 'ure' (Accenture), ' Corp', ' Enterprise'. Probes: 'Toshiba Enterprise' 0.96, ' Siemens' 0.63, 'Meredith Corp' 0.52, 'Apex Solutions' 0.20; 'solutions to the math problem' 0.01, 'starship Enterprise' 0.02. Near misses keep the business topic and drop the names.
